clips.src: Antonio – He Made $15M Trading... With No Mentor, No Course
clips.headline: NO MENTOR. NO COURSE. $15M.
clips.layer: Numbers card: Army at 17 · zero English · self-taught · ~$15M

clips.line: I'll tell my parents I'm leaving college
clips.headline: HE FAKED COLLEGE TO TRADE
clips.layer: Story captions + end card: 'Would you have done it?'

clips.line: It makes you so angry, you never forget it
clips.headline: WHAT HIS DAD SAID STUCK
clips.layer: Slow push-in, soft caption, no music bed

clips.headline: $23,000 GONE… AGAIN
clips.layer: Lesson card: 'Risk per trade decides who survives'

clips.line: not getting a job to trade full-time is just an excuse
clips.headline: DON'T QUIT YOUR JOB TO TRADE

clips.line: Can I fix it? Yes. Let me move on.
clips.headline: THE 2-QUESTION RULE
clips.layer: On-screen flowchart: Can I fix it? → Yes: fix it / No: let it go

clips.line: I made £500 in like 10 seconds because of news
clips.headline: £500 IN 10 SECONDS

clips.line: Give me one year exactly… I don't have to do masters
clips.headline: HE GAVE HIS MUM A 1-YEAR DEADLINE

clips.line: we're not taught how to budget, invest, or file taxes
clips.headline: WHAT SCHOOL NEVER TAUGHT YOU
clips.layer: Checklist overlay ticking: bank account · budget · invest · taxes

clips.line: if this didn't work out, my degree was useless
clips.headline: ALL IN. NO BACKUP PLAN.
clips.layer: Split text: 'If it fails…' vs 'If it works…'

clips.line: first payout… exactly £1.5k in like a week
clips.headline: FIRST PAYOUT: £1.5K IN A WEEK

clips.line: see someone start from zero, and then they push
clips.headline: THE BEST PART ISN'T THE MONEY
